{{Top|leg}}
'''Gutcher Gorai''' was an individual who [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Gutcher Gorai]]
Gutcher Gorai appeared aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
